texture_prompt.text: Lunar energy facility cable maintenance bridge. Rough grey anti-slip coated steel deck, dark graphite metal side cable trays and handrails, brushed metal support joints, narrow orange hazard edge markings. Restrained manufacturing detail, clean industrial hard science fiction. Neutral albedo, no baked lighting or strong shadows, no rust, no camouflage. Preserve geometry, bridge opening, end connections and UV layout.
